newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sunright wins US$1 mln Motorola order.
newsitem.headline: Sunright wins US$1 mln Motorola order.

text.p: Sunright Limited said on Friday it had secured another order for its parallel test and burn-in system, GEN-1 from Motorola for US$1 million.
It said in a statement the deal was signed with Motorola's subsidiary, KES Systems Inc located in Tempe, Arizona.
The GEN system, when fully configured, sells for about US$500,000 and is used to test 16-megabit DRAMs.
Sunright, a company specialising in semi-conductor testing, is currently working with a few Korean and Japanese memory manufacturers who are showing interest in GEN.
It said it was optimistic it could sell 20 systems in this financial year, which ends on July 31.
